newsitem.title: USA: Albany, NY Council approves $103 mln budget- paper.
newsitem.headline: Albany, NY Council approves $103 mln budget- paper.

text.p: Albany, N.Y., $103 million budget, which holds taxes level due to $12.3 million of surplus funds, was approved by the Common Council on Monday, the Albany Times Union said on Tuesday.

The plan, approved by a 14 to 1 margin, includes a few cushions, including a $6.5 million outlay for shipping waste out of town after the Rapp Road landfill closes next year. The city expects to get state approval for a dump expansion before the year is out.
Last year, the council rejected Mayor Jerry Jennings' budget, but were told that under law it was automatically approved.
The paper said a suggestion to give alderman more power to modify the mayor's budget could come up in a charter review now underway.
